presets.label: Calm climb
presets.description: Steady, relaxed signal for the whole climb. The light stays wide and the ember settles.

presets.label: Rising tension
presets.description: Starts relaxed, then muscle tension builds in longer and longer bursts until it holds.

presets.label: Jaw clench bursts
presets.description: Relaxed signal broken by short, sharp jaw clenches every few seconds.

presets.label: Mixed climb
presets.description: Calm, then a tense stretch, then recovery: the full arc the game is built around.

presets.label: Noisy pin
presets.description: Relaxed signal, then one pin picks up interference for a while. Shows how the reading holds up against a poorly seated pin.
